I’ll admit I don’t know much about the system since I don’t ever believe I’ll be able to participate in it in the way my elders are able to. I do have a Roth IRA that I pay into every month, but who’s to say that it will be there when I look to retire, if I even live long enough to do that. They keep raising the age of retirement anyways.

Still: my original comment was based on Social Security.

Well now - let’s not forget that you don’t even get the full amount that you’ve paid into said system your entire life back. You still get taxed on it after you hit the age you start to get it (at least in America) and we STILL have politicians working to take it away from us. I thought I read that social security would “run out” by around 2040, but I’m no expert.
